component.script: function report(p) as object c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Child") c.id = "src" copy = c.clone(true) m.top.insertChild(copy, 0) out("clone.childCount", [copy.getChildCount().toStr()]) out("clone.findChild", [show(m.top.findNode("child"))]) out("clone.findInnerOnly", [show(m.top.findNode("innerOnly"))]) return invalid end function
